about: A class and an injured bird

lines.text: One rainy morning, a small bird flew into our classroom window and fell
to the floor. Our form teacher picked it up gently and placed it
in a shoebox lined with tissue paper. She told we that the bird
was only stunned and needed a quiet place to rest. Nobody are allowed
lines.note: Agreement and tense: 'nobody' is singular and the story is in the past, so it is 'was'.

lines.text: to touch it, although many of us wanted to. During recess, we search
